terms.term: CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory (Unit 6)
terms.definition: CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory is a core topic in Grade 9 Information technology covering essential principles on pages 181-210.
terms.definition_amharic: ሲፒዩ (CPU)፣ ራም (RAM) እና ሮም (ROM) ሜሞሪ በ9ኛ ክፍል ኢንፎርሜሽን ቴክኖሎጂ (IT) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 181-210 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።
